import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MAX_NUM = 1234567890L;
    static final double epsilon_value = 1e-8;
    static final int pattern_length = 9;
    static final double PI_CONST = 3.14159265358979323846;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        long[] factorials = new long[N + 1];
        long[] inv_factorials = new long[N + 1];

        factorials[0] = 1;
        inv_factorials[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            inv_factorials[i] = (inv_factorials[i - 1] * modExp(i, mod - 2, mod)) % mod;
        }

        long[] count_vec = new long[M + 1];
        long[] sum_vec = new long[M + 1];

        Arrays.fill(count_vec, 0);
        Arrays.fill(sum_vec, 0);
        count_vec[0] = 1;

        for (int m = 1; m <= M; m++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                long left_c = (count_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k]) % mod;
                long right_c = (count_vec[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k]) % mod;
                long left_s = (sum_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k]) % mod;
                long right_s = (sum_vec[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k]) % mod;

                count_vec[m] = (count_vec[m] + left_c * right_c % mod * (m + 1)) % mod;

                long term1 = (left_s * right_s) % mod;
                long term2 = (left_c * right_s) % mod;
                long term3 = (left_s * right_c) % mod;
                long sum_add = (term1 + term2 + term3) % mod;
                sum_add = (sum_add * (m + 1)) % mod;

                long k_part = (long)k;
                long numerator = k_part * (k_part + 1) + (m - k_part) * (m - k_part - 1);
                numerator /= 2;

                sum_vec[m] = (sum_vec[m] + sum_add + (left_c * right_c % mod) * numerator % mod) % mod;
            }
            count_vec[m] = (count_vec[m] * factorials[m - 1]) % mod;
            sum_vec[m] = (sum_vec[m] * factorials[m - 1]) % mod;
        }

        long[][] count_res = new long[N + 1][M + 1];
        long[][] sum_res = new long[N + 1][M + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(count_res[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(sum_res[i], 0);
        }

        count_res[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            int max_j = Math.min(i, M);
            for (int j = 0; j <= max_j; j++) {
                count_res[i][j] = count_res[i - 1][j];
                sum_res[i][j] = sum_res[i - 1][j];

                if (j == i) {
                    count_res[i][j] = (count_res[i][j] + count_vec[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod;
                    sum_res[i][j] = (sum_res[i][j] + sum_vec[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod;
                }

                for (int k = 1; k <= Math.min(j, i - 1); k++) {
                    long c = (count_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k]) % mod;
                    long s = (sum_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k]) % mod;

                    long val1 = (count_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c) % mod;
                    long val2 = (sum_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + count_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s) % mod;

                    count_res[i][j] = (count_res[i][j] + val1) % mod;
                    sum_res[i][j] = (sum_res[i][j] + val2) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        long final_ans = (sum_res[N][M] * factorials[M]) % mod;
        System.out.println(final_ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long modExp(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur) % mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
